name: Franco Seiler
bio: Franco Seiler is a full-stack developer running a software studio, with over 4 years of experience building web platforms for startups and businesses. He works across the stack with React, Next.js, Node.js, Python and TypeScript, taking products from first call to production: custom e-commerce, SaaS platforms, internal tools and corporate sites. His work emphasises scalable architecture, payment integrations, and infrastructure that clients own outright.
availability: Available for new projects and collaborations. Works remotely with clients in Europe, the Americas and globally.
experience: 4+ years building and shipping production web platforms
achievements: Shipped 22 client and product projects, from custom e-commerce to enterprise SaaS.
Built payment integrations with Mercado Pago and Stripe, including webhook-driven order and subscription lifecycles.
Delivered a multi-tenant compliance platform alongside a Canadian engineering team, serving motor carriers across the US and Canada.
Reduced runtime errors by around 20% through end-to-end TypeScript adoption.
Improved page load times by 30% through React performance work and rendering strategy.

workExperience.title: Full Stack Developer
description: Design, build and ship end-to-end web platforms for startups and businesses, owning each project from first call to production.
Work across the full stack with React, Next.js, Node.js, Python and TypeScript, building everything from custom e-commerce and SaaS products to corporate sites.
Develop backends with Node.js/Express, NestJS and Python (Django, Django REST), modeling data in PostgreSQL and MySQL with Prisma, TypeORM and Sequelize.
Design and document REST APIs, reusable component libraries and design systems with SCSS and Tailwind CSS to keep delivery fast and consistent.
Integrate payments and third-party services: Mercado Pago and Stripe (subscriptions, webhooks), Google OAuth, cloud storage (AWS S3 / GCS) and transactional email.

workExperience.title: Co-Founder & Full Stack Developer
description: Co-founded the company and led technical direction, taking products from idea to launch.
Built scalable applications with Python, Next.js, React and TypeScript, keeping the codebase clean, typed and maintainable.
Designed the overall architecture and project structure, defining conventions, folder layout and reusable modules for long-term scalability.
Developed and integrated databases and APIs, optimizing frontend-backend communication and query performance.
Deployed and maintained services on Linux servers, configuring environments, domains, SSL and automated deployments.

workExperience.title: Full Stack Developer
description: Built full-stack applications with React, Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL in a fast-paced product team.
Developed REST and GraphQL APIs with Prisma ORM, strong validation layers and clear error handling.
Integrated AI features using the OpenAI API — generative descriptions, smart filters and content automation.
Contributed to scalable, microservice-oriented architectures and shared internal libraries.
Implemented automated testing (unit and integration) to raise reliability and prevent regressions.

workExperience.title: Front End Developer
description: Built and maintained single-page applications with React and Redux for production clients.
Increased user retention by 15% and improved conversion rates by 20% through UX and performance work.
Contributed to an internal component library, reducing feature development time by 30%.
Developed custom React hooks and reusable patterns to improve code modularity and consistency.
Optimized rendering performance and bundle size, improving page load and responsiveness.

technologyExperiences.React: Franco has built multiple interactive user interfaces with React, including an e‑commerce platform and a task management app. He leveraged hooks, state management (Redux, Zustand), and performance optimizations to improve load times and responsiveness.
technologyExperiences.Next.js: Franco used Next.js for his portfolio and freelance projects to enable server‑side rendering, static site generation, and seamless routing. He integrated dynamic API routes and optimized the initial load with image and script optimization.
technologyExperiences.TypeScript: Franco applied TypeScript across all frontend and backend layers, reducing runtime errors by around 20% and enhancing code quality and developer experience.
technologyExperiences.Node.js: Franco built RESTful and GraphQL APIs with Node.js and Express, handling database connections, authentication, and business logic for various apps including e‑commerce and collaboration tools.
technologyExperiences.PostgreSQL: Franco used PostgreSQL extensively in his task manager and e‑commerce projects to model relational data with Prisma/Sequelize, write optimized SQL queries, and ensure data integrity.
technologyExperiences.Docker: Franco containerized applications end‑to‑end with Docker, defining Dockerfiles and docker‑compose for development and CI setups.
technologyExperiences.GraphQL: Franco built GraphQL APIs using Node.js and Express with Apollo Server, enabling flexible client queries in production apps.
technologyExperiences.Python: Franco worked on backend utilities and scripts using Python and FastAPI/Django for specific freelance tasks, including data processing and small web services.
technologyExperiences.MongoDB: Franco used MongoDB with Mongoose in his e‑commerce platform to model product catalogs, orders, and user sessions in a flexible document‑based structure.
technologyExperiences.AWS: Franco deployed apps to AWS, managing CPU/storage with EC2 or Lambda, databases with RDS and S3 for static asset hosting.
technologyExperiences.Supabase: Franco used Supabase extensively in StartOn for backend-as-a-service, leveraging its PostgreSQL database, Edge Functions, real-time subscriptions, and authentication system. This enabled rapid development of complex features like multi-role authorization and private messaging.
technologyExperiences.Jest: Franco wrote unit tests for frontend components and backend endpoints to safeguard functionality and reduce regressions.

softSkills: Attention to detail with clean, accessible design
Curious and eager to learn continuously
Open to feedback and continuous improvement
